programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spidsen af spyddet
programme.desc: Efter at en planet i Commonwealth bliver angrebet af pyroformere fra Pyrian, er Dylan tvunget til at kæmpe for at beskytte den nye planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlens hvælving
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer, der lokker ham til en planet med "ild og is".

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens besætningen er fanget i en kamp mellem to nietzscheanske stolthedspunkter, fanger besætningen en fjendtlig person, der hævder, at hans stolthed har et kort over slipstrømmen

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestæt
programme.desc: Et forkert sving efter at have forladt en slipstream sender Andromeda ind i Prolon-systemet. De redder en flugtkapsel fra en sikker katastrofe, men stoltheden vil have den tilbage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernes tusmørke
programme.desc: Besætningen søger efter en forsvundet koloni af nietzscheanere og opdager en anden besætning, der i hemmelighed har hjulpet dem

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, vredens dag
programme.desc: Besætningen installerer en ny AI i et nyt slagskib fra Commonwealth, og naturligvis går tingene ikke som de skal.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet af en sidste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser nietzscheanerne om, at han er en reinkarnation af Drago Museveni
programme.sub-title: Skygger kastet af en sidste hilsen

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As the Tide Turns
programme.desc: The woman was dead. The man had been shot four times and survived. When the man's version of events contradicted physical evidence, investigators turned to forensic science to paint a clearer picture of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin

programme.title: Gone Fishin

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1

programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gruppen tager til Vegas for at se Brody optræde som dj, og Justin føler sig fanget mellem Audrina og Stephanie. Der udbryder naturbrande i Malibu og Kaitlyn frygter for Brodys liv, da han bliver i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn skal forholde sig til naturbranden i Malibu. Audrina træffer en svær beslutning om Justin. Mischa skal til audition til en stor filmrolle og Heidi vil genoplive sin popsangerinde-karriere.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Rygterne flyver efter en skadaløs hændelse, der involverer Brody og Stephanie. Audrina får et chok, da Justin tager en flot date med til middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brodys 'A-liste-galla skaber splid i gruppen, da hun ekskluderer visse medlemmer. Audrina overrasker alle ved at genantænde et forhold til en gammel flamme. Spencer chokerer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynns ægteskab er i uføre da rygterne svirrer om deres kærlighedsliv. Efter at have lovet eksklusivitet begynder Brandon at tvivle på sit forhold. Audrina lægger sin skilsmisse bag sig og indleder en ny forretningssatsning.
programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterer Brody med hans ægteskabsstatus og sandheden afsløres. Brandon træffer en endelig beslutning om sit forhold til Ashley. Whitney deler en følelsesladet nyhed med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad jonglerer sin designeruddannelse, et krævende praktikantophold og en uforudsigelig bofælle, der saboterer hendes jobevent, så hun lærer hurtigt, at alt er større i L.A., inklusive hendes problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Hemmelighedshullet slår til, da Angela bliver sat i den varme stol, og Nurys skal træffe en vigtig beslutning. Ekserne mødes med en overraskende eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah vender tilbage for at finde ud af, om hun er kommet sig helt over sin eks. Sandheden afsløres, da alle i huset tvinges til at evaluere deres forhold baseret på en løgnedetektortest.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter i anden del af Ex on the Beach Reunion, da løgnedetektoren tvinger Morgan til at indrømme sandheden, et nyt forhold afsløres og utroskab afdækkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser tager til et vinterlandskab for at se, om de kan finde deres næste udkårne, men de ved ikke, at deres ekser vil komme stormende som en lavine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callum og Nicoles ekser skaber store problemer. En forbindelse bliver skabt og hurtigt brudt igen. En ny eks kommer, og den første hotte date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gør et akavet forsøg på at skabe en forbindelse. Det går hedt for sig i Hemmelighedssaunaen for en lumsk single. Den første eks bliver frosset ude.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får opmærksomhed fra flere ekser, og det er Adore ikke glad for. En charmerende overraskelse afbryder den hotte date.
programme.sub-title: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Hemmelighedssaunaen åbenbarer et mysterium for Marlond eks. To singler kæmper om den samme eks. Bølgerne går højt til isceremonien, når en eks foretager et overraskende træk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgia og Callums forhold bliver sat på prøve, da den eks, de frygtede mest, dukker op. Bølgerne går højt over La Demis seneste flamme. En romantisk hot date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: En chokerende Hemmelighedssauna betyder, at singlerne må være på vagt ved isceremonien. Allie og Nialls ustabile forhold gør Allie usikker.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt date bliver til et perfekt mareridt for et par. Niall får seriøs konkurrence om Allies følelser. Marion og La Demi har svært ved at hitte ud af deres situation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia og Callum møder deres hårdeste kritiker. Marion kommer i klemme, når en eks ankommer, der bringer forholdet til La Demi i fare. Isceremonien tager en uventet drejning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: Da en første kærlighed ankommer, får det gyldne par sig en overraskelse. En ny forbindelse og en overraskede beslutning ved den hotte date får Tyranny til at se rødt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Beach Of Doom
programme.desc: 8 sexede singler håber at finde kærligheden på en paradisstrand. Men der er en twist, for drømmeferien ødelægges, da deres ekskærester dukker op, en after en. Nogle for at få hævn, andre for at få forholdet til at blusse op igen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Mad Frank
programme.desc: Drømmeferien, hvor 8 singler leder efter kærligheden bliver ramt af mere grus i maskineriet. Vicky fortsætter sin affære med Ross. Marcos eks, Frankie, opdager at hun har en rival. Ash og Chloe får sig et chok, da den næste eks dukker op.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Don't Hate The Player
programme.desc: Den fjerde ekskæreste ankommer til stranden og skaber problemer for singlerne: Ross føler Chloes vrede, da hans forhold til Vicky udvikler sig. Det går vildt for sig mellem Taitha og Ash og Marco og Frankie når bristepunktet med Emily.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Playing With Fire
programme.desc: Den femte ekskæreste ankommer til stranden for at overraske Vicky og Ross. Tingene bliver værre for Talitha og en chokerende afrejse efterlader alle i panik, for hvilken eks bliver nu den næste, som ankommer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Tuletha's Got A Secret
programme.desc: Ash kunne ikke være mere chokeret over ankomsten af den sjette eks på stranden. Emily og Liam er på en date fra helvede, Farah bliver forelsket og Talitha bliver rystet, da en hemmelighed truer med at slippe ud og ødelægge hendes forhold til Ash.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth's Out
programme.desc: Ross siger til sin eks Chloe, at han vil prøve igen, og Jack prøver med Emily. Ashs verden forandrer sig, da Joss afslører det hemmelige kys med Talitha, og sevfølgelig dukker der også endnu en eks op på stranden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Champion Of Exes
programme.desc: Ash og Talitha har kun lige slået op, da han finder sammen med Chloe. Shelby og Ross kommer hinanden nærmere, da de overnatter på en kirkegård. Vickys eks kommer, hvilket hun ikke har glædet sig til, og så går det løs på stranden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Liam's Final Stir Of The Pot
programme.desc: Da Vickys anden eks, Ricci, dukker op, splittes gruppen. Ash flipper ud på Liam med alvorlige konsekvenser. Dan truer med at flippe ud på Ricci, og Ricci og Vicky prøver at få en slags afslutning, men uden succes.
programme.sub-title: Liam's Final Stir Of The Pot

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love at First Sight
programme.desc: Otte single-kendisser mødes i en luksusvilla. Det slår gnister for Joey. Calum får en overraskelse og Lateysha brænder varm på en bad boy. De første kendisser ankommer, men ender det i tårer?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Breaking Point
programme.desc: At se Joey og Lorena sammen bliver for meget for Ellie. Latisha bliver efterladt af Michael, men en ny, sexet kendis får hende til at svæve på en sky. Calum og Marisa fortsætter med at flirte.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: John flipper skråt, da Stephen bager på Julia. Tori og Camille er begge ude efter den samme fyr. Presset er stort for de 'gyldne par' som skal i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Huset er i oprør, da Gio og Kaylens perfekte forhold begynder at slå revner. Asaf går i seng med den forkerte person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Forholdet mellem Gio og Kaylen får alle op på dupperne, da Gio bager på Julia og alle andre piger i huset. Cam og Victoria har en nat, der ikke er værd at huske.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam og Eva-tema fører til jalousi, når parrene blandes. En kærlighedstrekant tager form, og der bliver ballade, når John, Tyler, Stephen og Gio prøver at forstå deres forvirrede hjerter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinlig udfordring får ekserne til at begynde at sprede rygter. Gio og Stephen får endelig sandheden at vide om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamle konflikter kommer op til overfladen og et stort skænderi fører til chok og tårer. Med kun to parceremonier tilbage prøver deltagerne desperat at lave en strategi for at vinde.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet, da den tiende og sidste parceremoni nærmer sig. Strategien fører gruppen til at tro på visse par, men Asaf er splittet mellem at følge sit hjerte eller sit team.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singler flytter ind i et hus i New Orleans og prøver at sætte 11 perfekte par sammen for at vinde en million dollar. Par falder pladask for hinanden og kærlighedstrekanter dannes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcoms opfører sig som en rigtig player og kommer i klemme mellem Diandra og Nurys. Keith og Alexis prøver at knuse hinandens hjerter ved at date andre.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love in Limbo
programme.desc: De stærkeste par i huset bliver angrebet, da folk begynder at stille spørgsmålstegn ved deres stærke bånd. Michael ryster huset, da han prøver at ødelægge flere forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmløs leg bliver enden på et par. Frustrationerne vokser mellem par, der knytter sig for meget til hinanden og singler, der har svært ved at skabe kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: MTV Teen Mom
programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Da distriktsanklager Jim Garrison (Kevin Costner) nærlæser rapporten om mordet på præsident Kennedy, får han mistanke om, at der ligger mere bag end det, der er offentligt kendt.

programme.title: Under træet
programme.desc: Agnes smider Atli ud hjemmefra og nægter ham at se deres datter Ása. Atli må flytte hjem til sine forældre, der selv er i problemer i en bitter nabostrid omkring deres store smukke træ, der kaster en skygge på naboens terrasse.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: GOOD KIDS følger fire dydsmønster elever fra Cape Cod, der netop har afsluttet deres high school uddannelse. De har brugt hele deres studietid på at stræbe efter topkarakterer.

programme.title: The Etruscan Smile
programme.desc: Rory MacNeil er en barsk mand, der modvilligt forlader sine elskede Hebriderne og rejser til San Francisco for at søge lægebehandling. Han flytter ind hos sin søn og hans familie, og hans liv er fuldstændig forandret af hans kærlighed til sit barnebarn.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den aften, hvor Abigail, en enlig mor til to små børn, møder Ben på en bar, finder de for sjov på en liste over ting, de skal gøre, inden deres tænkte brud med hinanden, selv om de ved, at de aldrig vil indlede et forhold.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: To af de seks seriøst mentalt forstyrrede forfattere bag gyserparodien SCARY MOVIE har igen haft nallerne i klemme i stavepladerne ogbarslet med en film, der én gang for alle pander de …

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun er tilfreds med at være en kvik, men doven surfer, indtil han en dag læser en roman af den anerkendte forfatter Martin Skinner. Han forlader Orange County for at læse på Standford University og lære at skrive.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: Velkommen til Sin City - byen, som tiltrækker de seje, de korrupte og dem med et knust hjerte. Nogle kalder den mørk og hårdkogt, mens skurkagtige betjente, sexede kvinder og desperate selvtægtsmænd kalder den for deres hjem.

programme.title: Seraphim Falls
programme.desc: Fem år efter den amerikanske borgerkrig rammes en nedslidt mand i en lysning af et skud i skulderen. Han flygter, og oberst Morsman Carver træder frem. Han er ude efter hævn, og det bliver en jagt, der fører de to mænd vidt omkring i Amerika.

programme.title: The Rules of engagement
programme.desc: Oberst Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) er en elitesoldat med en pletfri karriere, indtil en rutineoperation i Yemen ender i en katastrofe. Demonstranter foran den amerikanske ambassade går amok og åbner ild.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: A Christmas Feast
programme.desc: Det er jul, og familien Oliverio gør sig klar til De Syv Fiskes Middag, en italiensk madtradition. Tony, en ung mand med store drømme og et endnu større hjerte, er med i forberedelserne og spekulerer på, om han mon vil finde kærligheden denne jul

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman (Seven, Red, Batman Begins) kendt men aldrende skuespiller møder på sin research til en ny rolle en smuk spansk kassedame, der er mere end træt af sit job, som består i at servicere de kunder som har 10 eller færre varer.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singlekvinde med fokus på karrieren i New York bliver tvunget til at forholde sig til følgerne af et forlist forhold, da hendes ekskæreste hyrer hendes firma. En moderne udgave af Jane Austens roman ”Kærlighed og svaghed”.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Det lesbiske ægtepar Nic og Jules havde den perfekte familie. Men de får sig et chok, da husets to teenagebørn opsøger den sæddonor, der er deres biologiske far. En øko-hippie ved navn Paul. En ren feel-good komedie.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Fake celebrity clairvoyant Williams preyed on the elderly by performing fake readings, including one where he directed his client to a forged will.

programme.title: Under Arrest: My Name Is Mr. Duck
programme.desc: A suspected sex trade worker is assaulted, a drunk suspect attacks police after crashing into their vehicle and a man under arrest becomes violent inside a police car.

programme.title: Exhibit A
programme.desc: A serial rapist in Lafayette, Louisiana is finally caught thanks to a local investigator and a Canadian forensic scientist, who developed “geographic profiling.” This analytical tool helps investigators figure out where a serial criminal lives.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Hoddle Street Massacre
programme.desc: A soldier opens fire on innocent civilians in one of Australia's most notorious mass killings.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The murder of Stephen Harvey, one of Kansas City's most promising young jazz musicians, and the acquittal of his suspected killer outraged the city and nearly led to rioting.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia
programme.desc: Derek Percy was imprisoned for the murder of 12-year-old Yvonne Elizabeth Tuohy, after abducting her from a Victorian beach in July 1969.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Wrongly Released
programme.desc: This special episode shines a light on criminals who have been brought to justice for one crime only to be released to commit further terrible acts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Sarah Payne
programme.desc: Eight-year-old Sarah Payne's disappearance and murder shocked the nation. Here, Sarah's mum reveals her tireless campaign to protect other children from paedophilia.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: One of the wealthiest doctors in Arkansas finds trouble when she meets a ruthless con man who convinces her to give him more that a million dollars. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Bette Lucas, the most popular philanthropist in the wealthy town of Tyler, Texas, dies mysteriously and her son Steven is accused of murder.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 205 - Charity Frauds (Illness/Disaster)
programme.desc: Society?s altruism can be easily affirmed through the donations given to charities in times of need - however, there are individuals out there that want to exploit these good-natured donations and re-direct them into their own pockets.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Jeremy Bamber
programme.desc: An investigation into Jeremy Bamber's brutal murder of his family in Essex, which occurred in 1985. Sentenced for life, he still maintains he is innocent. Is the right person behind bars?

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Peter Falconio
programme.desc: After stopping to help a man who flagged down their car, tourists Peter Falconio and Joanne Lees are attacked. Joanne managed to escape, but Peter's body was never found.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Caught on Tape
programme.desc: Jerrick Jackson and his fiancé pulled into their driveway and are met by several assailants. Jerrick tries to stop them from entering his home, shots are fired and Jerrick is killed.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Liquor Run
programme.desc: Eric Clark was a loving son, brother and husband, who started up a side bartending business. While driving to pick up alcohol for an event, Eric is shot dead in a neighborhood driveway.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: In the early morning of March 7, 1986, multi-millionaire Stan Cohen was shot three times in the head with his own gun as he slept in his Miami mansion.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Factor X

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine
programme.desc: Leah e Zac tentam construir uma casa na árvore, mas a tarefa acaba sendo mais difícil do que parecia. Por isso, Leah pede às suas gênias uma casa na árvore e fica nervosa quando as duas transformam sua casa em uma casa feita de árvores!

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine
programme.desc: Quando a comida de festa que Leah preparou é esmagada pelo carro automático de Zac, Leah precisa descobrir como contornar o problema e pensar em outra guloseima para levar ao evento.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne
programme.desc: Quando o Blaze sente cheiro de fumaça na garagem da Cidade do Eixo, ele corajosamente conduz seus amigos para fora em segurança.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne
programme.desc: Enquanto apostam uma corrida, o Blaze e o Esmagador descobrem um reino medieval onde acontecerá uma corrida real. Os dois carros se tornam cavaleiros para poderem competir com os outros cavaleiros na corrida pelo reino.

programme.title: Top Wing

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: A GRANDE família de Rhonda está vindo para uma reunião. Os cadetes dançam com esses rinocerontes animados.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.sub-title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Façam suas malas e corram rápido para o chegar ao aeroporto! Nesse episódio, os Bubble Guppies precisarão de sua ajuda para voar em avião através do céu e das nuvens. A turma aprenderá tudo sobre como funciona um avião.

programme.sub-title: Rusty's Runaway Sled / Rusty's Sky Pie Delivery

programme.sub-title: Rusty's Sick Fix / Rusty's Journey to the Centre of Sparkton Hills

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Imprisoned
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet
programme.desc: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Storm
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.desc: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Return to Omashu
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Swamp
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Avatar Day
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blind Bandit
programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Zuko Alone
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
programme.desc: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

programme.title: iCarly: iGør
programme.desc: Da en iCarly-fan frier til sin kæreste live i webshowet, bliver vennerne shanghajet til at komme til brylluppet. Men da bruden får kolde fødder, må Carly klarer ærterne.
